name: PolyTranslate AI for Polylang
author: almhdy

sections.description:
PolyTranslate AI for Polylang brings powerful AI-based translation tools to your multilingual WordPress website.

This plugin uses your own API keys to connect with top translation engines such as OpenAI (ChatGPT), DeepL Pro, Google Translate, and OpenRouter. It makes it easy to translate your site’s content and metadata with a single click — directly within the WordPress admin.

This plugin is not affiliated with the developers of Polylang.

Note : This plugin works with Polylang. Make sure you have Polylang installed.

PolyTranslate AI includes both free and premium features. See below for the breakdown.

Free Features

  • Translate WordPress posts and pages instantly
  • Translate WooCommerce Products
  • Translate custom post types

Premium Features

  • All Free Features
  • Translate categories and tags
  • Translate custom taxonomies
  • Translate Elementor Pages
  • Bulk translation for faster content localization
  • Translate SEO meta descriptions for:
    • Yoast
    • Rank Math
    • SEOPress
    • All in One SEO Pack

External Services

PolyTranslate AI connects to the following third-party APIs to provide translation services. You must provide your own API keys for these services:

  1. OpenAI (ChatGPT/GPT-4)

    • Purpose: Translates content using AI models.
    • Data Sent: Post/page content, language codes, and your API key.
    • Links: Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

  2. DeepL Pro

    • Purpose: High-quality machine translations.
    • Data Sent: Post/page content, source/target languages, and your API key.
    • Links: Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

  3. Google Translate API

    • Purpose: Machine translations via Google Cloud.
    • Data Sent: Post/page content, language codes, and your API key.
    • Links: Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

  4. OpenRouter.ai

    • Purpose: Alternative API gateway for multiple AI models.
    • Data Sent: Post/page content, language codes, and your API key.
    • Links: Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

Note: This plugin only sends data to these services when you manually trigger a translation or use bulk translation. Your API keys are stored securely in your WordPress database and are never shared with the plugin developer.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/polytranslate-ai directory, or install it via the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to PolyTranslate AI > Settings to configure your API keys and preferences.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes, the core plugin is free and includes powerful features. Some advanced functionality (like taxonomy translation and extended SEO plugin support) is available with a premium license.

Is this plugin affiliated with Polylang?

No. This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by the developers of Polylang.

Do I need API keys?

Yes. You will need your own API keys for OpenAI, DeepL, Google Translate, or OpenRouter to use their respective services.

Can I translate custom post types and taxonomies?

Yes, this is available in the premium version.

Which SEO plugins are supported?

  • Premium: Yoast, Rank Math, SEOPress, All in One SEO Pack
